opportunities.name: Nashor realm execution
opportunities.objective: Spend the seven-second isolated duel on repeated AP attacks.
opportunities.mechanic: Darkness Rise adds 0.4 AP magic damage to attacks and activates its aura after three qualifying attacks/basic abilities. Nashor and Dusk and Dawn add attack payloads, Terminus needs real attacks for mixed penetration and Riftmaker rewards the sustained Realm of Death. Q's isolation multiplier gives a spell payoff while R restricts the duel to one opponent.
opportunities.requiredState: Need target access inside R, sufficient attack time and W shield management.
opportunities.failure: A slippery opponent can waste most of the seven seconds; low defenses make the exit dangerous.
opportunities.test: Compare attacks, passive activation and Q damage in seven-second duels versus a target with an escape.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Death Realm isolation does not remove enemy mobility or automatically fully stack Terminus.

opportunities.name: Bloodmail magic mace hybrid
opportunities.objective: Test Q's documented AD scaling without treating its damage as physical.
opportunities.mechanic: Obliterate has a 1.2 AD statFormula=2 term plus 0.7 AP and deals magic damage, amplified on a single target. Bloodmail's health-to-AD and Riftmaker's health-to-AP create a dual health conversion; Shojin increases qualifying spell/passive damage and Abyssal improves close magic output. Visage supports W's shield and optional remaining-shield healing.
opportunities.requiredState: Need isolated Q hits, stored W damage and enough contact to ramp sustained effects.
opportunities.failure: AD does little for E/passive AP ratios; missing Q undermines the conversion payoff.
opportunities.test: Compare Q damage per gold and W absorption across bought-health levels, tracking physical attacks separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Lethality does not improve an AD-scaled magic Obliterate, and W recast spends the remaining shield.

ruledOut.reason: Mordekaiser has no mana; Tear and mana pools cannot fuel his abilities.

unknowns: Q raw AD statFormula and W storage caps need live damage checks; Death Realm temporary stolen stats are not permanent stacking.

builds.name: Nashor realm execution
builds.summary: Spend the seven-second isolated duel on repeated AP attacks.
builds.goal: Spend the seven-second isolated duel on repeated AP attacks.
builds.hypothesis: Darkness Rise adds 0.4 AP magic damage to attacks and activates its aura after three qualifying attacks/basic abilities. Nashor and Dusk and Dawn add attack payloads, Terminus needs real attacks for mixed penetration and Riftmaker rewards the sustained Realm of Death. Q's isolation multiplier gives a spell payoff while R restricts the duel to one opponent.
testPlan: Required state: Need target access inside R, sufficient attack time and W shield management.
Compare attacks, passive activation and Q damage in seven-second duels versus a target with an escape.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: A slippery opponent can waste most of the seven seconds; low defenses make the exit dangerous.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Death Realm isolation does not remove enemy mobility or automatically fully stack Terminus.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Terminus, Rabadon's Deathcap, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with Nightfall dealing [80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 + characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 7.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (1.2) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.7) × AP] magic damage, increased to [(80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 + characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 7.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (1.2) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.7) × AP) × (1.3 / 1.35 / 1.4 / 1.45 / 1.5)] if it hits only a single enemy.

Passive: Mordekaiser stores [45]% of the damage he deals and [7.5]% of the damage he takes.

Active: Mordekaiser gains the stored damage as Shield. He may Recast this Ability to restore [(0.35 / 0.375 / 0.4 / 0.425 / 0.45) × 100]% of the remaining Shield as Health.

Minimum Shield: [(0.05) × Stat(12)]
Maximum Shield: [(0.3) × Stat(12)]

Passive: Mordekaiser gains [(0.05 / 0.075 / 0.1 / 0.125 / 0.15) × 100]% Magic Penetration.

Active: Pulls enemies in his direction, dealing [60 / 80 / 100 / 120 / 140 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage.

Mordekaiser banishes a champion to the Death Realm with him for [7]s, stealing [10]% of their core stats for the duration.

If Mordekaiser kills that enemy in the Death Realm he consumes their soul, keeping the stats he stole until the target respawns.

Mordekaiser's Attacks deal an additional [(0.4) × AP] magic damage.

Mordekaiser cloaks himself in negative energy after hitting 3 basic Abilities or Attacks against champions or jungle monsters. This cloak deals [5 + (0.3) × AP] plus [characterLevelInterpolation(1 → 5; raw flags preserved)]% max Health magic damage per second and grants him [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.03, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.029999999329447746, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.029999999329447746, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 19, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.029999999329447746, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 24, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.029999999329447746, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 30, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.029999999329447746, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] Move Speed.
